name: beech
_doc: European beech (Fagus sylvatica)-like broadleaf. Spiral (distichous-ish) phyllotaxis, moderate apical control, plagiotropic laterals, shade-tolerant (low shed threshold). Ranges [U]: H 25-35 m at maturity, DBH 0.3-0.8 m, open-grown crown ratio 0.6-0.85, order-1 branch angle 40-65 deg.
_doc_thickening: cambium_k: m^2 of new ring area per unit of bud light Q flowing through an internode per season (Pressler-style light-driven secondary growth); calibrated on stand seed 7 against the Wytham DBH-height relation (validate.py). height_max lowered so the asymptote sits inside Wytham's 20-25 m canopy.
